title: LED colours: themes, picker, standby show
author: made with Claude
description: Seven SETTINGS rows. LED THEME recolours the key LEDs (STOCK, PINK, SOFT, LAVENDER, OCEAN, SUNSET, CUSTOM); LED EDIT and LED RED/GREEN/BLUE set any colour family's colour (0-31), previewed on the trig keys. LED IDLE (OFF/30S/1M/2M/5M) starts a light show (LED SHOW: COMET, RAINBOW, BREATHE) when no key, knob or sound has come for that long; the first key or knob only wakes it. The settings are saved (one eMMC block the stock firmware never uses, 0x60000) and restored at power-on; the first time, the theme is PINK and LED IDLE 1M.
